title: Website SEO, Health & Broken Link Auditor Input Schema

startUrl.title: Start URL
startUrl.description: The initial URL to start auditing. Must be HTTP or HTTPS.

confirmAuthorizedUse.title: Confirm Authorized Use
confirmAuthorizedUse.description: I confirm that I own or have explicit authorization to audit the target website. Checking this box confirms existing authorization; it does not create permission. Mandatory for all domains except example.com.

maxPages.title: Maximum Pages to Audit
maxPages.description: Maximum number of internal pages to crawl and audit (default 25, hard max 250).

maxCrawlDepth.title: Maximum Crawl Depth
maxCrawlDepth.description: Maximum link click depth from startUrl (default 3, max 10).

maxLinksPerPage.title: Maximum Links per Page
maxLinksPerPage.description: Maximum number of links extracted and queued per page (default 100, max 500).

checkExternalLinks.title: Check External Links
checkExternalLinks.description: Check status of external links (checked via HEAD/GET once, never recursively crawled).

maxExternalLinks.title: Maximum External Links to Check
maxExternalLinks.description: Maximum total unique external links to check across the entire audit (default 250, max 2000).

includePerformance.title: Include PageSpeed Performance
includePerformance.description: Whether to fetch PageSpeed Insights data for top pages (disabled by default).

pageSpeedApiKey.title: Google PageSpeed API Key
pageSpeedApiKey.description: Optional user-provided API key for Google PageSpeed Insights. Never logged or stored in output.

maxPerformancePages.title: Maximum Performance Pages
maxPerformancePages.description: Maximum number of pages to run through PageSpeed Insights (default 1, max 5).

compareWithPreviousRun.title: Compare with Previous Run (Baseline Tracking)
compareWithPreviousRun.description: Compare current findings against persistent baseline to identify new, resolved, and materially changed issues.

baselineKey.title: Custom Baseline Key
baselineKey.description: Optional custom key-value store key name for baseline storage. If omitted, derived from target domain.

generateHtmlReport.title: Generate HTML Report
generateHtmlReport.description: Generate a self-contained, interactive HTML audit report saved in the Key-Value Store.

generatePdfReport.title: Generate PDF Report
generatePdfReport.description: Generate a downloadable PDF audit report saved in the Key-Value Store.

failOnSeverity.title: Fail Run on Issue Severity Threshold
failOnSeverity.description: If set, the run will exit with failure (ciPassed=false) if any issue meets or exceeds this severity.
